responsibility_boundary: The pnpm lockfile is the generated dependency-closure authority for the public npm workspace inventory; this waiver covers only the deterministic closure expansion required to add the four GitHub webhook KFX packages.
cohesion_rationale: The 81 added lines are one lockfile closure generated by the same workspace inventory change; splitting or hand-editing the lockfile would make the published package graph less reproducible.
rejected_split_alternatives: No split is applicable: publishing a subset of the four interdependent reference-suite packages would violate the public inventory closure, and separate lockfiles are not supported by the monorepo.
affected_tests_and_qualification: ./shifu check:npm-package-registry; ./shifu pack:npm-release-inventory; ./shifu check:source; Candidate source acceptance / check; Delivery Warrant; merge_group.
